in August 2026, up 249% YoY, while its self-mining hash rate reached 79.9 EH/s.
increased to approximately $86M in August from $76M in July, with 4.33K GPUs deployed and 3.998K GPUs under external subscription.
The company fully contracted its 9.5 MW A102 facility in Malaysia, representing more than $800M in expected revenue, with revenue recognition expected to begin in Q1 2027.
It also secured an additional 65.1 MW at its Malaysia campus through a 10-year data center services agreement, taking total AI cloud capacity there to 86.8 MW.
Beyond Malaysia, Bitdeer signed a non-binding agreement to develop an initial 30 MW AI data center in Bhutan, with a potential expansion path to 500 MW.
The company also acquired 200 acres near its existing 563 MW Rockdale facility to support future AI and high-performance computing infrastructure.
